responsibility: Declares the public streaming-compression interface for LTO section I/O. It forward-declares lto_compression_stream and exposes the start/block/end APIs for compression and uncompression, including the callback-based interface used by LTO section readers and writers to feed raw bytes and receive compressed or decompressed output. This header is the narrow API boundary to lto-compress.cc, not the implementation of any codec or section handling logic.
same_name_distinction: Declares the external API for the lto-compress pair, while the same-stem implementation file gcc/lto-compress.cc contains the private stream representation and the actual zlib/zstd compression and decompression logic.
